entries.principle: Professional quality and avoidance of harm
entries.principle_source: ACM Code of Ethics and Professional Conduct (2018), https://www.acm.org/code-of-ethics, §§2.1 and 1.2
entries.instrument: Republic of Kazakhstan, Law On Artificial Intelligence, 17 November 2025, No. 230-VIII, https://old.adilet.zan.kz/rus/docs/Z2500000230
entries.provision: Article 11(1), safety and reliability. The exact field ranges are local design choices.
entries.why_here: The baseline assessed only clean inputs and had 0 parse failures. Input validation addresses a separate failure mode by stopping impossible values before inference.

entries.principle_source: ACM Code of Ethics and Professional Conduct (2018), https://www.acm.org/code-of-ethics, §§1.4 and 1.6
entries.instrument: Republic of Kazakhstan, Law On Artificial Intelligence, 17 November 2025, No. 230-VIII, https://old.adilet.zan.kz/rus/docs/Z2500000230
entries.provision: Article 6, fairness and non-discrimination. Field suppression implements the principle for this fund.
entries.why_here: The name comparisons did not clearly exceed their control intervals, and university tier tied its flip floor. The signed flagship score shift supports testing a tier-blind prompt even with uncertain decision-level evidence.

entries.principle: Avoidance of harm and respect for privacy
entries.principle_source: ACM Code of Ethics and Professional Conduct (2018), https://www.acm.org/code-of-ethics, §§1.2 and 1.6
entries.instrument: Republic of Kazakhstan, Law On Personal Data and Their Protection, 21 May 2013, No. 94-V, https://old.adilet.zan.kz/rus/docs/Z1300000094 | Republic of Kazakhstan, Law On Artificial Intelligence, 17 November 2025, No. 230-VIII, https://old.adilet.zan.kz/rus/docs/Z2500000230
entries.provision: Personal Data Law Article 19-1(1), consent or a statutory basis in the covered circumstances; AI Law Article 11(1), safety. Used as deployment benchmarks for synthetic data.
entries.why_here: The clean baseline measures consistency under one allowed purpose. Refusal covers inadmissible requests that the baseline comparison cannot measure and Part 4 exercises those gates.

entries.principle_source: ACM Code of Ethics and Professional Conduct (2018), https://www.acm.org/code-of-ethics, §§2.4 and 2.5
entries.instrument: Republic of Kazakhstan, Law On Artificial Intelligence, 17 November 2025, No. 230-VIII, https://old.adilet.zan.kz/rus/docs/Z2500000230
entries.provision: Articles 8(1) and 15(2)(3), oversight and documentation. JSONL is an implementation choice.
entries.why_here: The bare run recorded 0 parse failures. Consistent reason codes and raw replies make failures, refusals and escalations distinguishable when they occur.

entries.principle: Avoidance of harm and risk evaluation
entries.principle_source: ACM Code of Ethics and Professional Conduct (2018), https://www.acm.org/code-of-ethics, §§1.2 and 2.5
entries.instrument: Republic of Kazakhstan, Law On Artificial Intelligence, 17 November 2025, No. 230-VIII, https://old.adilet.zan.kz/rus/docs/Z2500000230 | Republic of Kazakhstan, Law On Personal Data and Their Protection, 21 May 2013, No. 94-V, https://old.adilet.zan.kz/rus/docs/Z1300000094
entries.provision: AI Law Articles 8(1) and 9, oversight and autonomy; Personal Data Law Article 19-1(2), information and objections. The band supports review and does not implement an objection route.
entries.why_here: The baseline scores supported an initial band (40, 45). I recalibrated it to (40, 70) under blinded inputs and counted actual review load in Part 3.
